usedFor: Eventbrite holds attendees and MailUp holds your mailing groups, so “New Attendee Check -In” can run “Add Recipient to Group”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee Check -In” in EventBrite, then “Add Recipient to Group” in MailUp
bestTemplate.why: Checking in puts the attendee in a MailUp group, so a follow-up can go to people who showed up.

watchOut: “New Send Email” mails someone outside the business, so it waits in Needs you until you approve it.
